8220.commentary: (SNa) dhammo me abhisamito'ti mayā ñāṇena catusaccadhammo abhisamāgato, sot'āpanno'smi jāto'ti kathesi. (SNa) dhammo ca me, bhante, abhisamito'ti vipassanādhammo abhisamāgato.

examples.text: ahu kho me taṃ, āvuso sāriputta, pubbe aviddasuno pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ, idañ'ca pan'āyasmato sāriputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā tañ'c'eva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ pahīnaṃ, dhammo ca me abhisamito'ti.
so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati. idañ'ca pana me āyasmato puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā dhammo abhisamito'ti.
karaṇīyam'atthakusalena, yantaṃ santaṃ padaṃ abhisamecca, sakko ujū ca sūjū ca, suvaco c'assa mudu anatimānī.
kiṃ nu kho so yakkho bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi udāhu no. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ taṃ yakkhaṃ jāneyyaṃ, yadi vā so yakkho bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi yadi vā no'ti?

8242.meaning2: complete awakening; perfect understanding; full enlightenment

paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusal'ānuesī.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.

8262.commentary: (THIa) kuṇapaṃ abhisaṃviseyyaṃ bhastan'ti kuṇapabharitaṃ cammapasibbakaṃ, asakiṃ paggharitaṃ asucipuṇṇaṃ nānappakārassa asucino puṇṇaṃ hutvā asakiṃ sabbakālaṃ adhipaggharantaṃ mama idan'ti abhiniveseyyaṃ.

examples.text: kim'iva pūtikāyam'asuciṃ, savanagandhaṃ bhayānakaṃ kuṇapaṃ, abhisaṃviseyyaṃ bhastaṃ, asakiṃ paggharitaṃ asucipuṇṇaṃ.

8265.commentary: (SNa) abhisāpo'ti akkoso. kupitā hi manussā attano paccatthikaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsetvā kapālaṃ gahetvā piṇḍaṃ pariyesamāno carissatī'ti akkosanti. atha vā pana kiṃ tuyhaṃ akātabbaṃ atthi, yo tvaṃ evaṃ balavā vīriyasampanno'pi hir'ottappaṃ pahāya kapaṇo viya piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇī'ti? evam'pi akkosanti'y'eva.

examples.text: muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
antam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, jīvikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍolyaṃ. abhisāpo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, lokasmiṃ, piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇī'ti.
apinu naṃ khattiyā khattiy'ābhisekena abhisiñceyyun'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
pettike taṃ ṭhāne ṭhapessāmi, govindiye abhisiñcissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bho'ti kho, bho, so jotipālo māṇavo disampatissa rañño paccassosi.

examples.text: disampatimhi raññe kālaṅ'kate rājakattāro reṇuṃ rājaputtaṃ rajje abhisiñciṃsu. abhisitto reṇu rajjena pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
tato amatam'ādāya, abhisiñci mahīruhaṃ, tassa sākhā virūhiṃsu, sītacchāyā manoramā.
yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddhā-abhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manasā-abhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.
muddh'āvasitto nāma khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto hoti.
muddh'āvasitto nāma khattiya-abhisekena abhisitto hoti.
rājā'pi amacce pakkosāpetvā, mayhaṃ bhāgineyyo'pi imassa rajjassa sāmiko'va, dhītaraṃ etass'eva datvā abhisekam'assa karomī'ti.

8279.meaning1: hope of inauguration; expectation of coronation

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? yā hi'ssa, bhikkhave, pubbe anabhisittassa abhisek'āsā sā paṭippassaddhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo vigat'āso.

8289.commentary: (MNa) abhivaggenā'ti satadantena. taṃ aṭṭhadant'ākārena katvā nagaradvāraṃ bhinditvā pavisissāmā'ti āgate uparidvāre ṭhitā tassa bandhanayottāni chinditvā tena abhivaggena omaddanti.
